rows.whatWasWrong: The packet wrote eight participant-identity values onto 600-00228, the fee-waiver application -- docket number, case name, name, street address, city/state/zip, email and home/cell phone on page 1, and the participant's name on page 2 at field 117, the Printed Name line of Section 5 beneath 'I declare that the above statement is true and accurate ... I will be subject to the penalty of perjury' -- on a form the same packet's participant-instructions.md and its own bound instruction pages twice told the reader not to complete or file. The same map refused the other 66 fields of that form for the recorded reason 'no filing fee is charged on this track, so the fee-waiver branch is not applicable and this participant-supplied field is never populated with participant data on this route'. A packet may not fill a form in and tell the reader not to fill it in.
rows.whichHalfWasFalse: The controlling record settles it and no legal input was needed. legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json, packetSets[vt_exp_decriminalized-set], component vt_exp_decriminalized-fee-waiver-application-3, carries requirement 'conditional' with conditionDescription 'Only where a fee is charged; on this track none is.' The held fee answer for this route is that no fee is charged (32 V.S.A. Sec. 1431(e)'s $90 reaches only sealing a conviction under 23 V.S.A. Sec. 1201(a)). The condition is not met, the form is not filed, and the instruction page was right: the prefills were the false half. The docket number on a perjury declaration's Printed Name line was wrong under either reading and is gone under this one.
rows.howItWasRepaired: In this family's own builder only. The eight 600-00228 entries in POLICY_600_00228 moved from WRITE to a new NOT_FILED policy, which the existing feeWaiverNotApplicable branch already routes into a recorded refusal carrying that same reason, requiredBeforeFiling false. The form is still DELIVERED, exactly as the Judiciary publishes it, because the manifest carries it as a component of the set -- the treatment the sibling vt_seal_nonconviction-set already records for the identical form on the identical no-fee reasoning, whose FEE_WAIVER_COMPONENT_REQUIREMENT shape (nothingIsWrittenOnIt: true, deliveryTreatment 'delivered_unfilled') is now recorded here too, in production-field-map.json and reports/rendered-artifacts.json. A build-time assertion reads the OUTPUT BYTES and refuses the build if 600-00228 carries any drawn value in either fixture; the map was honest before this repair while the artifact still carried the eight values, so the map is not the place to check.
rows.noSharedModuleChanged: No shared module was touched. The change is confined to scripts/build-census-v1-vt_exp_decriminalized-set.mjs, which builds this family alone.
rows.instructionProseUnchanged: participant-instructions.md and the composed instruction pages are byte-identical to the committed ones: they already said, once and consistently, that no fee is charged on this track and that 600-00228 is not to be completed or filed. Nothing was added to paper over the contradiction; the write was removed instead.
